title: Partner Utility Program Schedule: Lawn Restoration Rates for Utility Line Protection Plans
content:
# Partner Utility Program Schedule: Lawn Restoration Rates

Partner programs schedule for the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

## Rule

Lawn partner schedule rate: a plan enrolled through Lakeshore Water Authority whose premium has been remitted through that utility's bill within the lawn partner window takes the Lakeshore lawn rate; a plan enrolled through Riverbend Municipal Utilities whose premium has been remitted through that utility's bill within the lawn partner window takes the Riverbend lawn rate; every other plan takes a lawn partner schedule rate of one. Lawn windows counted in months run back from the day the payment is booked: an entry falls within a lawn window when fewer whole months than the window separate its posting date from that day. The lawn partner schedule rate multiplies the plan's landscaping restoration allowance in the lawn restoration figure.

## Schedule

| Enrolled through | Premium remitted on that utility's bill within the last 12 months (lawn partner window) | Lawn partner schedule rate |
|---|---|---|
| Lakeshore Water Authority | yes | 1.1 (Lakeshore lawn rate) |
| Riverbend Municipal Utilities | yes | 1.05 (Riverbend lawn rate) |
| either of these | no | 1 |
| another utility, or direct | either | 1 |

## Window count

The 12-month lawn partner window runs back from the day the lawn restoration payment is booked; a premium payment with the utility bill as its payment method is within it when fewer than 12 whole months separate its posting date from that day.

*Hypothetical boundary cases (payment booked 5 March 2026):* a utility-bill remittance posted 6 March 2025 is within the window; one posted 5 March 2025 is not.

## Hypothetical example

Lakeshore Water Authority plan with a recent utility-bill remittance, allowance of $250.00 assumed: $250.00 multiplied by 1.1 is $275.00.
